description: Applied manually in Cloudflare; reference configuration, not an automatic deployment. Keep before the existing AI and scanner block rules. The preceding /up health exception remains unchanged.
name: Challenge public HTML and profile traffic
expression:
not cf.client.bot and (
(http.request.uri.path contains "/user/" or
http.request.uri.path contains "/usuario/" or
http.request.uri.path contains "/utente/" or
http.request.uri.path contains "/anvandare/" or
http.request.uri.path contains "/bruger/" or
http.request.uri.path contains "/gebruiker/" or
http.request.uri.path contains "/kullanici/")
or (
http.host in {"freecause.com" "www.freecause.com"}
and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}
and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/")
and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ads/")
and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/")
and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/")
and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin")
and (
any(http.request.headers["accept"][*] contains "text/html")
or http.request.uri.path contains "/petition/"
or http.request.uri.path contains "/petitions"
or http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/da" "/de" "/el" "/en" "/es" "/fr" "/it" "/nl" "/pl" "/pt" "/ro" "/ru" "/sv" "/tr"}
)
)
)
